items.headline: Why Is Albemarle (ALB) Up 5.4% Since Last Earnings Report?
items.snippet: Albemarle posted second-quarter 2026 adjusted earnings of $3.75 per share, up from 11 cents a year ago, beating the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $3.35 by 11.9%, supported by stronger lithium pricing, Specialties growth and productivity gains.

items.headline: Albemarle's Lithium Math Turns Brutal
items.snippet: JPMorgan now expects lithium prices to remain in the low-$20-per-kilogram range, down from mid-$20s. Albemarle faces delays at the Greenbushes CGP3 plant following a June fire, restarted Aug. 1. ALB shares were down 5.16% at $134.21 at the time of publication.
